specification.objective: Replace credential-like placeholder text in login-rate-limit tests with an unmistakably synthetic invalid value, preserving test behavior and eliminating the secret-scanner false positive.

requirements.statement: Use a non-secret deterministic invalid login value that satisfies the LoginRequest minimum length in all negative-auth test cases.
Keep the existing account/source throttling, response, and persistence assertions unchanged.
No production code or runtime credentials are changed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tests use a deterministic synthetic value with at least eight characters and no credential-like literal.
The focused login rate-limit test suite passes with the same expected response codes and assertions.
Only the test file and this POLIS contract change; production files remain untouched.

invariants.statement: The placeholder is never a real credential and is rejected by the seeded test account.
Rate-limit semantics and configured thresholds are unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: A real credential, token, or secret is introduced into test source.
Production logic or authentication response behavior changes.

inputs.statement: The backend login rate-limit tests submit invalid passwords through the existing test client and SQLite fixture.

outputs.statement: A credential-free test placeholder with unchanged rate-limit test behavior.

failure_semantics.statement: Any response other than the existing 401/429 expectations or any unexpected test failure is a failure.
